description_en: Retrieves the details of a semantic model
description_zh: 获取 Semantic Model 详情
name: GetContextModel

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model. This value is obtained from the request path /context-models/{name} and must be the name of an existing model under the current account. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported
parameters.help_zh: 上下文模型的标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}，须为当前账号下已创建的模型名；仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）
parameters.name: name

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the details of the specified context model
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回指定上下文模型的详细信息

createdAt.description_en: The time when the model was created. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, such as 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z
createdAt.description_zh: 模型创建时间，RFC3339 UTC 格式，形如 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z

description.description_en: The description of the model. The maximum length is 1,024 characters. If no description is provided during creation or update, an empty string "" is returned
description.description_zh: 模型描述，最长 1024 个字符；创建或更新时未填写则返回空串 ""
description.example: End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment

displayName.description_en: The display name. If not set, an empty string "" is returned and the name field is not used as a fallback. When displaying the name, use the displayName || name fallback logic
displayName.description_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退
displayName.title_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退。

name.description_en: The identifier of the context model. It is the same as the name in the request path. It is unique under the same Alibaba Cloud account and cannot be modified after creation
name.description_zh: 上下文模型的标识，与请求路径中的 name 一致；在同一主账号下唯一，创建后不可修改

additionalProperties.description_en: The list of selected Logstore names under the project, which is a string array. ["*"] indicates all Logstores under the project and cannot be mixed with specific Logstore names
additionalProperties.description_zh: 该 Project 下已框选的 Logstore 名列表，为字符串数组。["*"] 表示该 Project 下的全部 Logstore，不可与具体 Logstore 名混写

items.description_en: The name of a selected Logstore under the project. A value of "*" indicates all Logstores under the project
items.description_zh: 该 Project 下已框选的 Logstore 名称；取值为 "*" 时表示该 Project 下的全部 Logstore

sources.description_en: The referenced sources. The keys are project names, and the values are lists of selected Logstores under each project, which is consistent with the structure submitted during creation. ["*"] indicates all Logstores under the project. Otherwise, it is a list of exact Logstore names. If no sources are referenced, an empty object {} is returned
sources.description_zh: 引用的源：以 Project 名为 key，值为该 Project 下框选的 Logstore 列表，与创建时提交的结构一致。`["*"]` 表示该 Project 下全部 Logstore；否则为精确的 Logstore 名列表。未引用任何源时返回空对象 `{}`
sources.title_zh: 引用的源：以 Project 名为 key，值为该 Project 下框选的 Logstore 列表，与创建时提交的结构一致。`["*"]` 表示该 Project 下全部 Logstore；否则为精确的 Logstore 名列表。未引用任何源时返回空对象 `{}`。

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the model was last updated. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, such as 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z. It is updated after the display name, description, or sources are modified
updatedAt.description_zh: 模型最近一次更新时间，RFC3339 UTC 格式，形如 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z；修改显示名、描述或 sources 后更新

v1_parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model. This value is obtained from the request path /context-models/{name} and must be the name of an existing model under the current account. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported
v1_parameters.help_zh: 上下文模型的标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}，须为当前账号下已创建的模型名；仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）
v1_parameters.name: name
